This is a Guide page.
This means the page will walk you through a specific task, strategy, or enemy/boss fight.
This guide was last updated for version 2.1.2.
This guide is not updated for the current version of the mod. Some or all of its advice may not be applicable to the current patch.

This guide is intended to list viable options for players depending on their progression stage and the class they've chosen. Think of this guide as a menu — there are many options to choose from, and you should try out different things to see which work best for you. Additionally, this guide is a starting point for you to build your own loadout from; you are encouraged to make changes to your liking. Be sure to check the individual pages for the items to understand how to craft them or their functionalities.

You should note the following things:

  • This guide is written assuming you are playing on Expert difficulty and Revengeance Mode. This guide may not be accurate for Death Mode, or anything on Master difficulty.
  • Calamity changes many vanilla items and mechanics. You can read these changes here.
  • Summoner weapons and minions will only do 0.75x damage if used alongside weapons from a different class.
  • The rogue class is a new class created by the Calamity Mod. It has a unique stealth mechanic that adds new attacks to its weapons. Not using stealth and simply using the weapon as fast as possible is referred to as "spam".
  • Each of the entries are sorted by category and listed alphabetically. The order does not signify how powerful something is.
  • Each of the items listed here is good, so if you don't like one, try another!

Using the guide[edit]

This guide uses the following symbols to help you understand how to use some items:

† — This item can be difficult or risky to use, and requires boss preparation

C — This item is best used for crowd control, such as Events or Worm bosses

+ — Support items that debuff the enemy or benefit the player in some way, or secondary weapons that can be used occasionally

≤ — Or variants / upgrades

Δ — This item has significant Calamity changes by way of functionality

* — This item might be difficult and tedious to get at this stage

Ω — These items should be used together

Items restricted to Revengeance Mode or higher will be italicized.

Pre-Providence [edit]

The story of Calamity continues after defeating the Moon Lord. You can now craft new gear using Luminite Bars and Lunar Fragments. The next bosses to fight are Dragonfolly, who offers some weapons and an accessory, and the Profaned Guardians, who drop the Profaned Core needed to summon Providence.

Pre-Polterghast [edit]

Defeating Providence gives you access to new crafting materials: Divine Geodes and Uelibloom Ore, which allow you to craft Tarragon armor and stronger weapons. The Tainted Cloudberry can now be crafted to increase your maximum HP. Both Ravager and the enemies in the Brimstone Crag will start dropping Bloodstone, another valuable material. Additionally, Providence drops the Mark of Providence, allowing you to fight three new bosses, each of which offer opportunities for new equipment to ready you to face the Polterghast.

Pre-Devourer of Gods [edit]

Polterghast's defeat gives you Ruinous Souls, allowing you to craft Bloodflare armor and more gear. The Phantom Heart, the final mana upgrade, is now available. The third tier of the Acid Rain event has now been unlocked, and The Old Duke can be challenged for powerful weapons. Lastly, you should explore the fourth layer of the Abyss, as its minibosses will begin dropping new, powerful items, such as the exceptionally quick Bobbit Hook, which is the final and best hook in the game. All of this gear put together will prepare you for your next big challenge: defeating the Devourer of Gods.

The Witch's Broom or Brimrose mount is heavily recommended for this fight.

Pre-Yharon [edit]

Slaying The Devourer of Gods grants you Cosmilite Bars. Three new crafting materials are now available from buffed enemies: Darksun Fragments from the Solar Eclipse, Endothermic Energy from the Frost Moon, and Nightmare Fuel from the Pumpkin Moon. These can be combined with Necroplasm to create Ascendant Spirit Essence. The Cosmic Anvil is the key to your next set of powerful items. When all is said and done, it is time to challenge Yharon.

Pre-Exo Mechs/Supreme Witch, Calamitas [edit]

Defeating Yharon causes Auric Ore to generate underground. Combining them with the Yharon Soul Fragments dropped by the boss allows you to craft Auric Tesla armor and powerful Auric weapons. You should also craft the Sacred Strawberry, the final HP upgrade. Finally, it is time to challenge the Exo Mechs and Supreme Witch, Calamitas, the two final bosses of Calamity. It is up to you which order they are fought in; it is often helpful to defeat the easier one first so that its drops can be used on the one you struggle with more.

The Exo Box is heavily recommended for the Supreme Witch, Calamitas fight.

Endgame [edit]

Defeating the Exo Mechs and Supreme Witch, Calamitas allows you to combine Exo Prisms, Ashes of Annihilation, and Auric Bars into Shadowspec Bars. These are used to craft Demonshade armor and the developer items. Finally, you can challenge the Boss Rush event and the Primordial Wyrm boss using these new items.
